title: 第11章 把这个逆子抓回来第12章 他一个废物能去哪里
slug: 叛出家族后转身投靠魔族女帝
lines: “老师，你没有搞错吧？”
叶轩愣在原地，耳边是几个姐姐嘰嘰喳喳的关怀声，吵得他脑袋有些疼。
但比起这些，戒指內的灵魂体所说的，才让叶轩震惊到半天都说不出话来。
“不是叶家庇护他叶楚尘，而是叶楚尘影响了整个叶家的气运？”
“这这怎么可能？叶家可是荒古大陆上的不朽世家！！”
“一个人气运再强，也不可能”
叶轩话还没说完，就被戒指內的灵魂体给毫不留情的打断。
“哼，你一个从蓝星穿越而来的穿越者懂什么？”
“蓝星灵气枯竭，怎能与荒古大陆相比？他叶楚尘可是传说中的气运之子，身怀无上神体，有大帝之姿！”
“如今虽然沦为一个废人，但一身气运尚存，且因为不能修炼的缘故，他叶楚尘便將一身气运散给整个叶家，如今他被赶走了，叶家不仅气运散了大半，且因德不配位的缘故，导致整个叶家厄气丛生！！”
戒指內的灵魂体不知是何来歷，占卜推算的本事竟然比大姐叶凌月还强，最先推演出叶家气运骤降，厄气丛生的原因。
“其实不用我说，自你突破辟海秘境后，修为极其缓慢，再无寸进。”
“不止是你，就连叶家这几个女人，连同他们的家主和老祖在內，都因为叶楚尘的离开，修炼速度大大放缓。”
“叶楚尘若不回叶家，叶家家族再无可能突破圣王境！叶家老祖再无可能突破准帝秘境！叶家这几个女人哼哼！”
“而你叶轩，修行资质本就极差，若不能夺走叶楚尘的气运，加诸己身，恐怕这辈子都再也无法”
灵魂体话音未落，叶轩的身体微颤，脸色更是白得如同一张白纸似的，毫无血色。
儘管他不愿意承认，但叶轩知道，自己老师所说的不会假。
“小轩，你怎么了？”
“怎么脸色这么难看？莫不是哪里不舒服？”
“轩儿，你没事吧？”
叶灵儿、叶寒和叶清清也察觉到叶轩的变化，一个个急的嘘寒问暖，好似热锅上的蚂蚁。
“姐姐们，我我没事。”
“呜呜呜”
回过神来，叶轩深吸一口气，然后拱手冲坐在家主位上的叶鼎和身边的几个姐姐行了一礼后，睁著满是无辜的大眼睛，忧心忡忡地开口道：
“父亲，姐姐们，我我只是想到楚尘哥哥被赶出叶家，此刻不知是否安好，心里头”
“我我想楚尘哥哥了！”
content_en:
"Teacher, are you right?"
Ye Xuan froze on the spot, hearing the caring voices of several sisters in his ears, which made his head hurt.
But compared to these, what the soul body in the ring said shocked Ye Xuan so much that he was speechless for a long time.
"It's not that the Ye family protected him, Ye Chuchen, but that Ye Chuchen affected the fate of the entire Ye family?"
"How is this possible? The Ye family is an immortal family on the ancient continent!!"
"No matter how lucky a person is, it's impossible."
Before Ye Xuan finished speaking, he was mercilessly interrupted by the soul body in the ring.
"Hmph, what do you, a time traveler from Blue Star, know?"
"How can Blue Star compare with the Ancient Continent when its spiritual energy is exhausted? He, Ye Chuchen, is the legendary son of destiny. He possesses a supreme divine body and has the appearance of a great emperor!"
"Although he has become a useless person now, he still has his luck, and because he cannot practice, he, Ye Chuchen, has given away his luck to the entire Ye family. Now that he has been driven away, not only has most of the Ye family's luck been dispersed, but due to the mismatch of virtue, the entire Ye family has become filled with misfortunes!!"
The origin of the soul in the ring is unknown, and its ability in divination and calculation is even better than that of the eldest sister Ye Lingyue. It was the first to deduce the reason for the sudden drop in luck and bad luck in the Ye family.
"Actually, I don't need to tell you. Since you broke through the secret realm of Pi Hai, your cultivation has been extremely slow and you haven't made any progress."
"Not only you, but also the women of the Ye family, as well as their heads and ancestors, have greatly slowed down their cultivation speed because of Ye Chuchen's departure."
"If Ye Chuchen does not return to the Ye family, it will be impossible for the Ye family to break through to the Saint King Realm! It will be impossible for the ancestors of the Ye family to break through to the Quasi-Emperor Secret Realm! These women of the Ye family are humiliating!"
"As for you, Ye Xuan, your cultivation qualifications are extremely poor. If you can't take away Ye Chuchen's luck and give it to yourself, I'm afraid you won't be able to do it again in this life."
Before the soul body finished speaking, Ye Xuan's body trembled slightly, and his face was as white as a piece of white paper, without any blood.
Although he didn't want to admit it, Ye Xuan knew that what his teacher said was true.
"Xiaoxuan, what's wrong with you?"
"Why is your face so ugly? Could it be that you feel uncomfortable somewhere?"
"Xuan'er, are you okay?"
Ye Ling'er, Ye Han and Ye Qingqing also noticed the changes in Ye Xuan, and they all asked anxiously, like ants on a hot pot.
"Sisters, I'm fine."
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuu"
After coming back to his senses, Ye Xuan took a deep breath, then bowed to Ye Ding, who was sitting on the head of the family, and the sisters around him. He opened his big innocent eyes and said worriedly:
"Father, sisters, I just think about Brother Chu Chen being kicked out of the Ye family. I don't know if he is okay at the moment."
"I miss brother Chu Chen!"
